title: He is, she is
grammar: He is / She is / It is

scene.speaker: astrid
scene.bubble: Grammar magic: HE for boys, SHE for girls, IT for Pip's fish! Easy when you practise.
scene.intro: Grammar magic with Astrid and Freya! HE is for a boy: he is my brother, he is a doctor. SHE is for a girl: she is my friend, she is a teacher. And IT? IT is for things and animals: it is a fish, it is a book. He is, she is, it is — three little words that say who everybody is. Who is in your class? Point at them and say it correctly!

activities.title: Match the person with he, she or it.
Quick check · Choose he, she or it.

items.sentence: This is my ball. ___ is red.
My grandma is kind. ___ makes cakes.
Pip is a bird. ___ is black and white.

activities.title: Listen. Who is it? Write he, she or a name in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Astrid y Freya (jugando a adivinar personas).
data.script: Astrid: Guess the person! He is fast and he loves football. … Freya: Tomás! He is the fastest. … Astrid: She has yellow hair and many questions. … Freya: That's me! Freya! … Astrid: He is small, black and white, and he can fly. … Freya: Pip! He is our favourite bird. … Astrid: She is our teacher and her smile is big. … Freya: Miss Lily! She is so kind. … Astrid: All correct! You know everyone!

activities.title: Quick check · Choose the correct word.

items.sentence: My mum is a doctor. ___ helps people.

data.text: Point (kindly!) at classmates and say: "He is… She is…" with one nice word each (fast, kind, funny). Five people!

activities.title: Look at A and B. What is different?
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Write about 3 people and 1 thing at home: He is… She is… It is… (one sentence each).

outcomes.puede: Understand short simple dialogues about family, school, animals, food (Cambridge Starters Listening parts 1–4).
Answer picture-prompted questions; describe a picture in simple sentences.
Read 2–3-sentence texts; match pictures to words and short captions.
Copy words and complete short sentences (Starters Reading/Writing parts).
~450 words (Starters wordlist); Present simple, present continuous (limited), there is/are, like + -ing.
